g.text: Same fixed gen5 weights, sensors, observers, native plant and delay queues; only 64 learned states reset every 100 µs.

g.text: All 8 runs passed ±0.5 N. Force-peak changes were small/mixed; recentering changed strongly in TRAIN 96 and 139.

g.text: 7,800,008 native samples scored. Curves decimated for drawing. Development cases; no optimized memoryless baseline or final holdout claim.
